fact: On 4 May 2025 AUC's A2K4D centre held a multistakeholder roundtable on responsible AI in Egypt, the second after a 14 January 2025 roundtable on Egypt's proposed AI bill with recommendations offered.
title: Charting Egypt's Path to Responsible AI: Insights from the Multi-Stakeholder Roundtable hosted by the MENA Observatory on Responsible Artificial Intelligence (AI)
publisher: MENA Observatory on Responsible AI, A2K4D, American University in Cairo
